source_dataset: Autonomous Greenhouse Challenge, Second Edition (2019), official Version 2
source_unit: cumulative pump-on minutes in a day
clock: source Excel local-clock serial; timezone not declared
unscheduled_decrease: counter correction; retain previous high-water mark
missing_block: retain last valid counter; attribute accumulated increment at first resumed reading
volume_conversion: none; Cum_irr and Resources Irr are processed source quantities and not independent flow measurements
physical_flow_calibration: unresolved; do not select an area or flow rate using holdout error
